description: crate-jmap-mail-server/src/backend.rs and crate-jmap-chat-server/src/backend.rs both define SetError and BackendSetError<E> with identical structure and semantics. The only difference is that the mail-server SetErrorType has more variants (RFC 8621-specific ones). This is a type-design smell: shared types should live in a shared crate (e.g. jmap-types or a new jmap-server-types crate) rather than being duplicated. Duplication means future fixes to Display, From, or serde impls must be applied in two places and can drift. The idiomatic approach is a single parameterized or trait-based type.
title: SetError/SetErrorType duplicated verbatim across mail-server and chat-server
